title: Coproduct summands of scalar total realization
statement: For a finite commutative ring R, a scheme T, arbitrary cochain complexes P,Q of fixed-coefficient sheaves on its small pro-etale site, and integers a+b=n, let E be the specified scalar realization equivalence and e its ordinary tensor comparison [lem-sf-finite-scalar-tensor-complex], and use its specified total realization [def-sf-finite-scalar-representative-total-realization]. Then E(ι_{a,b}) followed by the nth component of total realization equals e at (P.X a,Q.X b) followed by the (a,b) injection into the total tensor of E(P),E(Q). No flatness or boundedness assumptions are needed.

from.place: Coproduct summand of the total tensor realization in the scalar projection comparison.

proof.text: For an arbitrary additive equivalence of preadditive monoidal categories with countable colimits, unfold the abstract total tensor comparison. Its value on a coproduct injection is the value of its defining ordinary tensor comparison, by HomologicalComplex.map_ιMapBifunctor_mapBifunctorComparisonX. Rewrite the shared representative wrapper by its app equation and specialize to the scalar realization. These steps are all proved in Lean, without sorry.

lean.statement:
theorem finiteScalarRepresentativeTotalRealization_ι (R : Type u) [CommRing R] [Finite R]
    (T : Scheme.{u})
    (P Q : CochainComplex
      (Sheaf (ProEt.topology T) (ModuleCat.{u + 1} (ULift.{u + 1} R))) ℤ)
    (a b n : ℤ) (h : a + b = n) :
    (sfIntrinsicModuleEquivalence T R).functor.map
        (CochainComplex.ιMapBifunctor P Q (curriedTensor _) a b n h) ≫
      ((finiteScalarRepresentativeTotalRealization R T).app (P, Q)).f n =
    (finiteScalarOrdinaryTensorIso T R).hom.app (P.X a, Q.X b) ≫
      CochainComplex.ιMapBifunctor
        (((sfIntrinsicModuleEquivalence T R).functor.mapHomologicalComplex (.up ℤ)).obj P)
        (((sfIntrinsicModuleEquivalence T R).functor.mapHomologicalComplex (.up ℤ)).obj Q)
        (curriedTensor _) a b n h
